title: Functions can return functions
why_it_matters: This pattern powers helpers, middleware and many React tools.
explanation: Because functions are values, one function can build and return another. multiplyBy remembers factor through a closure, so each function it creates has its own multiplier. It's a handy way to create small custom helpers from one template.
try_it: Build addTax(rate) that returns a function adding that tax to a price.
